What to understand at MT4

Random module drop
A reward with a chance to appear after a run. Repeating an eligible run provides repeated opportunities; reaching one very high wave does not guarantee it.
Wave Momentum
Software unlocked with MT5 that makes enemy kills contribute to faster wave advancement. You cannot rely on it before that promotion.

What you are working toward

  • The supplied research cites the v1.0.1 changelog for reducing the MT5 objective from 100 to 80 maximized modules. Check Headquarters for the full current objective list.
  • Complete the region requirement and fund the Workshop purchases without dismantling your working economy.

Milestone reference; the current game takes precedence. [S02] [S01]

A practical route through this stage

The order below is an editorial synthesis of the supplied community research. It is a suggested route, not the only valid build or a tested speedrun.

  1. Make a missing-module shortlist

    Open the Workshop collection and compare missing modules with the unlock reference. Separate random region drops from Laboratory and challenge rewards. This avoids repeatedly farming a region for a reward it cannot provide. [S06]

  2. Use short, repeatable runs for random drops

    Before Wave Momentum, the supplied community strategy suggests roughly waves 30–50 at a difficulty you can repeat quickly. Treat this as a starting point, not a fixed optimum. Compare successful runs per minute and survivability; a harder difficulty is not useful if it makes every run much slower or unreliable. [S06] [S13]

  3. Let automation support production

    Use small, verified Factory or upgrade routines to reduce repetitive work. Keep ingredients and resource conversions supplied. Avoid leaving a script running simply because it runs: check that its output helps fund the next Workshop purchases. [S07] [S04]

  4. Spend toward the promotion counter

    After your farming build works, maximize additional affordable modules until Headquarters registers the requirement. Check the in-game meaning of maximized for your available module tier. Increasing a few favorite modules while leaving the rest unfinished may not move the counter you need. [S01] [S02]

  5. Research the new software after promoting

    At MT5, prioritize Wave Momentum research. Inspect Duplicates when choosing a military perk: the supplied research recommends its protection for later promotions. Read when that protection begins rather than expecting it to restore a reset that already occurred. [S05] [S07]

If you are stuck

A guide says I need 100 modules

That is an older requirement flagged by the supplied research. Use the current Headquarters objective and the developer changelog.

I own enough modules but the objective is incomplete

Unlocked and maximized are different states. Check which modules have reached the required upgrade endpoint.

Ready to move on?

  • Headquarters confirms the maximized-module and region objectives.
  • You are ready to research Wave Momentum after reaching MT5.
After the promotion

The next objective shifts toward total module tier. Broad, affordable tier upgrades become increasingly important. [S02] [S05] [S07]
